verdict.rationale: Interview preparation is a fair axis for an ATS like Workable, but the evidence pack never mentions calendar invites, interview kits, scorecards, or feedback reminders. The candidate-rating API endpoint is an adjacent developer primitive, not automatic interviewer preparation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviewers get prepared automatically — calendar invites carry the interview kit, the scorecard, and reminders to submit feedback
